newsitem.title: UK: London shares start higher following Dow gains.
newsitem.headline: London shares start higher following Dow gains.

text.p: UK shares opened higher on Wednesday, underpinned by Wall Street's near 40-point advance overnight and news of an agreed bid in the regional electricity sector.
But trading volumes are expected to remain thin ahead of the Christmas holidays and as investors continue to worry about a possible near-term downward correction for U.S. shares.
"We're in the silly season (pre-Christmas) now and most people are content to stay away until they adjust portfolios in the New Year," one dealer said.
The FTSE 100 was up 2.1 points by 0840 GMT.
